name: 14617 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14617 (Rochester) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 51 of them (66%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14617 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14617 (Rochester) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 19% of all organizations here have no identified type.
